{
  "findings": [
    {
      "body": "In `.github/workflows/antigravity-review.yml:13`, the concurrency group expression uses `(github.event.action != 'edited' || github.event.changes.base.ref.from != '') && 'review' || github.run_id`. When a pull request title or description is edited, `github.event.changes.base` is undefined, evaluating to `null`. Under GitHub Actions expression rules, `null != ''` evaluates to `true` (type coercion compares 0 != NaN). As a result, the concurrency group resolves to `'review'` instead of `github.run_id`. With `cancel-in-progress: true`, any currently active review job is aborted on PR title or body edits, violating the design recorded in receipts.edn to preserve active reviews across irrelevant PR edits.",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": [
        ".github/workflows/antigravity-review.yml:13",
        "receipts.edn:37"
      ],
      "failure_trace": [
        "A pull request is opened and starts an advisory review in concurrency group 'antigravity-review-...-review'.",
        "The author edits the pull request title or description; GitHub dispatches a pull_request event with action 'edited'.",
        "The webhook payload contains 'changes.title' or 'changes.body', while 'changes.base' is undefined.",
        "In GitHub Actions expressions, 'github.event.changes.base.ref.from' evaluates to null; 'null != \\\"\\\"' evaluates to true.",
        "The concurrency group evaluates to 'review', cancelling the active in-progress review run."
      ],
      "line": 13,
      "path": ".github/workflows/antigravity-review.yml",
      "title": "Concurrency group cancels active reviews on PR title or description edits"
    },
    {
      "body": "In `.github/workflows/antigravity-review.yml:18`, the job execution guard specifies `if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.draft == false && (github.event.action != 'edited' || github.event.changes.base.ref.from != '') }}`. When a pull request's title or body is edited without changing the target base branch, `github.event.changes.base` is absent from the payload and evaluates to `null`. Because GitHub Actions evaluates `null != ''` as `true`, the condition evaluates to `true`, causing GitHub Actions to schedule and run a redundant code review for irrelevant PR metadata edits. The guard should verify base ref change presence directly (e.g. `github.event.changes.base.ref.from != null` or `github.event.changes.base != null`).",

        "The job 'if' condition succeeds and enqueues an unnecessary full review job on non-code changes."
      ],
